Schedule M page 2 line 3 net = 0.00 - 0.00 = 0.00; RI-1040 line 2 = 0.00. Line 3 modified federal AGI = 280,000.00 + (0.00) = 280,000.00. Standard Deduction and Exemption Worksheets: worksheet line 5 = 280,000.00 - 254,250.00 = 25,750.00, not more than 29,000; line 6 = 25,750.00 / 7,250 = 3.5517241, raised to 4; line 7 = 0.2000. Line 4 standard deduction: 10,900.00 (Single) x 0.2000 = 2,180.00. Line 5 = 280,000.00 - 2,180.00 = 277,820.00. Line 6 exemptions: 1 x 5,100.00 = 5,100.00 x 0.2000 = 1,020.00. Line 7 taxable income = 277,820.00 - 1,020.00 = 276,800.00. Line 8 tax on 276,800.00 by the schedule as numbers: 79,900.00 x 0.0375 = 2996.2500 + 101,750.00 x 0.0475 = 4833.1250 + 95,150.00 x 0.0599 = 5699.485000 = 13,528.86.
